Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 의뢰 실패로 인해 의뢰비를 받지 못하는 것에 불만이 있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> seems dissatisfied about not receiving payment after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は依頼に失敗したせいで、報酬が出ないことに不満を隠せないでいる。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎对于因为委托失败而拿不到委托费感到不满。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎對於因為委託失敗而拿不到委託費感到不滿。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble insatisfaite de ne pas recevoir les frais de commission en raison de l'échec de la requête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> scheint unzufrieden zu sein, weil sie wegen des fehlgeschlagenen Auftrags keine Auftragsgebühr erhält.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece insatisfecha por no recibir la tarifa de la comisión debido a la solicitud fallida.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece insatisfeita por não ter recebido a taxa da comissão devido ao pedido falho.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะไม่พอใจที่ไม่ได้รับค่าคอมมิชชันเนื่องจากคำขอไม่สำเร็จ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampaknya tidak puas karena tidak menerima biaya komisi akibat permintaan yang gagal.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ không hài lòng vì không nhận được phí ủy thác do yêu cầu bị thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> विफल अनुरोध के कारण कमीशन शुल्क न मिलने से असंतुष्ट लग रही है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Don't worry about it. It was just a minor quest anyway.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 気にするな、軽い依頼だっただろ？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 别在意，只是个小委托而已。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 別在意，只是個小委託而已。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ne t'inquiète pas. C'était une requête mineure, de toute façon.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Mach dir keine Sorgen. Es war sowieso nur ein kleiner Auftrag.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No te preocupes. De todos modos, era una solicitud menor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não se preocupe com isso. Foi um pedido menor, de qualquer forma.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่ต้องกังวลหรอกนะ มันเป็นแค่คำขอเล็ก ๆ น้อย ๆ เอง
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Jangan khawatir. Itu hanya permintaan kecil, kok.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đừng lo lắng. Dù sao thì đó cũng chỉ là một yêu cầu nhỏ thôi mà.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: चिंता मत करो। यह वैसे भी एक छोटा सा अनुरोध था।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 이걸 마시면 기분이 좀 나아질 거야.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: This should help you feel a bit better.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: これを飲めば、気分も晴れるはずだ。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 喝了这个心情会好一点。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 喝了這個心情會好一點。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Boire ça devrait te faire te sentir un peu mieux.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Das zu trinken sollte deine Stimmung etwas aufhellen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Beber esto debería hacerte sentir un poco mejor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Beber isso deve fazer você se sentir um pouco melhor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดื่มนี่แล้วน่าจะรู้สึกดีขึ้นนะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Minum ini pasti akan membuatmu merasa sedikit lebih baik.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Uống cái này vào chắc sẽ thấy khá hơn một chút đấy.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: इसे पीने से तुम्हें थोड़ा बेहतर महसूस होगा।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 다음을 생각할 수 있다는 사실이 마음에 든 것 같다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> seemed relieved knowing she could still think about what came next!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、「次」を考えられるようになったことが嬉しいようだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎很满意自己能考虑到「下次」这件事！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎很滿意自己能考慮到「下次」這件事！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Il semble que <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ait apprécié le fait que vous puissiez penser à la suite !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> scheint erfreut zu sein, dass sie über den nächsten Schritt nachdenken kann!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¡<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece complacida de poder pensar en el siguiente paso!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece satisfeita por poder pensar no próximo passo!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะพอใจที่เธอสามารถคิดถึงขั้นตอนต่อไปได้!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampaknya senang karena dia bisa memikirkan langkah selanjutnya!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ hài lòng vì cô ấy có thể nghĩ đến bước tiếp theo!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> इस बात से खुश लग रही है कि वह अगले कदम के बारे में सोच सकती है!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 화를 삭였지만, 아직 가슴에 응어리가 남은 모양이다…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> managed to calm down, but it looked like something was still weighing on her...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、怒りを飲み込んだが、まだ胸のうちは晴れないようだ…
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>虽然压下了怒火，但心里似乎还有疙瘩…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>雖然壓下了怒火，但心裡似乎還有疙瘩…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réprimé sa colère, mais il semble qu'il y ait encore un nœud persistant dans sa poitrine…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat ihren Ärger unterdrückt, aber es scheint, als würde sich immer noch ein Knoten in ihrer Brust befinden…
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ha reprimido su enojo, pero parece que todavía hay un nudo persistente en su pecho…
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> suprimiu sua raiva, mas parece que ainda há um nó persistente em seu peito…
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ระงับความโกรธไว้ได้แล้ว แต่ดูเหมือนว่ายังมีความรู้สึกค้างคาอยู่ในใจของเธอ…
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> telah menekan amarahnya, tetapi sepertinya masih ada ganjalan di dadanya…
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã kìm nén cơn giận, nhưng có vẻ như vẫn còn một nút thắt trong lòng cô ấy…
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अपना गुस्सा दबा लिया है, लेकिन ऐसा लगता है कि उसके सीने में अभी भी एक गांठ बची हुई है…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 활력 포션을 마시고 기운을 되찾은 듯하다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> seemed to regain her energy after drinking the Vitality Potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 活力ポーションを飲んで、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は元気を取り戻した！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>喝下活力药水后似乎恢复了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>喝下活力藥水後似乎恢復了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble avoir retrouvé ses esprits après avoir bu la potion de vitalité.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> scheint nach dem Trinken des Vitalitätstranks ihre gute Laune wiedergefunden zu haben.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece haber recuperado el ánimo después de beber la poción de vitalidad.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece ter recuperado o ânimo depois de beber a poção de vitalidade.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะกลับมามีชีวิตชีวาอีกครั้งหลังจากดื่มยาเพิ่มพลัง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampaknya telah mendapatkan kembali semangatnya setelah meminum ramuan vitalitas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ đã lấy lại tinh thần sau khi uống thuốc sinh lực.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> जीवन शक्ति औषधि पीने के बाद फिर से ऊर्जावान लग रही है।
